safety_and_source_limits.service_bulletin_reference_policy: Do not add bulletin/reproduction unless public official source verified; any workshop thresholds are context only, never numerical BMS diagnostic thresholds.

split_policy.existing_seeded_TR01_TR02_TE01_TE02: Retain historical IDs and seeds; no retroactive renaming, repeated measurements of previous comparisons excluded from new post-freeze scoring.
split_policy.new_seed_generation: Per episode use SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 string 'TAYCAN4R|<hypothesis>|<split>|<severity>|<replicate>|<physics|observer|aux|nuisance>', take first 8 hexadecimal digits as unsigned 32-bit integer; stable ordering and episode manifest written before running. Existing TR/TE historical seeds unchanged; revised episodes get new keys.
split_policy.nuisance_draw_policy: Randomize continuous nuisance scales uniformly in registered ranges using precommitted nuisance seed; persistent bias uniform within sampled half-width per sensor per episode, white innovations at each step. Assign structural factors acquisition_mode, counter_source and diff_motor_t_mapping by balanced deterministic 8-combo strata and SOC phi by 7-level deterministic round robin (see structural_nuisance_design); no parameter selected by outcomes. For paired faults use same environmental nuisance realization and stratification.
split_policy.validation_usage: Validation only for model/baseline selection and threshold settings; test locked until selected design frozen.

distribution_shift_pre_registered.reference: Train H00 nominal profile at assumed 25C ambient, if existing frozen Stage3 interface supports it.
distribution_shift_pre_registered.scenario: Whole-episode six-hour shifted driving profile with more regeneration and lower traction torque; nominal ambient 10C if existing interface supports it. Use same fixed training-derived charging boundary for matched hypotheses; no per-test tuning.
distribution_shift_pre_registered.allocation: Within each of three fault severities per hypothesis: 9 nominal and 8 shifted independent test episodes; H00 27 nominal and 24 shifted. Report performance by nominal/shift subgroup and pooled. Train and validation nominal; disjoint episode seeds for split. If ambient change unsupported, run shifted duty-cycle only with explicit ambient_shift_not_modeled flag.

statistical_precision_pre_registered.warning: These are approximate binomial calculations assuming independent same-distribution episodes. Report Wilson confidence intervals, use clustered bootstrap where repeats share drivers/seeds; worst-case p=0.5 gives larger widths; shift-stratified intervals wider.

structural_nuisance_design.method: Balanced, fixed stratification instead of stochastic discovery; all combinations treated as methodological alternatives, not true Porsche design.
structural_nuisance_design.counter_source_truth: EXCLUDED from main evaluation; optional explicitly labeled truth ablation only (not observable)
structural_nuisance_design.assignment: Eight combos (2x2x2) sorted lexicographically. Within each class/split/severity enumerate replicate=0..N-1; deterministically rotate the 8-combo list by SHA256 'TAYCAN4R|struct|hypothesis|split|severity' first byte %8; map replicate mod8. Balance differences across combos <=1 within each split/severity; record combo and seed per episode BEFORE execution. Report class-by-mode metrics with sample sizes; DIFF-mode is not a real sensor calibration.

soc_phi_assignment.method: Deterministic 7-level round robin over ordered independent episode indices within each hypothesis and split; rotation SHA256 of 'TAYCAN4R|phi|hypothesis|split' first byte %7, then assign grid[(replicate_global+offset)%7]. Applied to observer only; never retune by performance; make φ≥0.9995 sensitivity runs mandatory in both nominal and shifted subsets.
soc_phi_assignment.sensitivity: Per φ report measured bias/drift, error SD, diagnostic metric stratification, and exact-dt AR1 innovations; if φ leads clipping, record clipping frequency. The test may use high φ out-of-original-assumption-range 0.995; explicitly declared hypothetical extension.

structural_nuisance_design.nuisance_draw_scope: Per-episode continuous ranges from existing parameters_assumed (uniform sampling fixed seeds), while structural factors and φ follow the fixed assignment schedule.

energy_balanced_long_horizon.charging_boundary: Negative battery-side DC power injected before electrical balance; no charger/OBC subsystem simulated
energy_balanced_long_horizon.charge_power_design: For EACH prespecified driving profile (nominal and shifted), simulate independent training-only H00 reference 6h with fixed initial SOC; bisect battery-side charging power within [0,120] kW for at least 8 iterations and up to 12, testing final |SOC(6h)-SOC(0)|<=0.5 percentage point and full trajectory 30..80% at each iteration. Freeze ONE power per profile, reused for all fault classes, severities, structural modes, validation and test within that profile. Do not optimize on validation/test outcomes. Declare convergence failure (BLOCK) instead of silently adjusting.
energy_balanced_long_horizon.stress_abort_rule: If resulting battery model SOC crosses 30..80%, mark boundary violation and report with attempted energy and cause; do not clip or silently exclude.
energy_balanced_long_horizon.previous_results_6h: SUPERSEDED; do not use old B01 B02 B04 metrics

charge_power_bisection.termination: both after >=8 iterations and |SOC_final - SOC_initial| <=0.5 percentage point, AND min/max SOC within [30,80]%; otherwise up to 12 iterations. If not met, record nonconvergence and DO NOT run dependent episodes.
charge_power_bisection.linearized_sanity: With 6 x 12min charge blocks and ASSUMED 70 kWh usable capacity, ∂SOC_final/∂P≈(1.2 h /70kWh)*100 =1.7142857 pp/kW. Bracket width at iteration 8:120/2^8=0.46875 kW; half-width 0.234375 kW implies approx 0.4018 pp worst midpoint quantization. Nonlinear dynamics still require explicit simulator residual.

energy_balanced_long_horizon.confounding_guard: Same duration (6 h), numerical dt, SOC initial state and segment lengths in nominal and shifted. Only prespecified duty cycle and optionally supported ambient parameter differ; do not conflate duration and shift.

matched_M01_I01.objective: For EACH prespecified profile NOMINAL_6H / SHIFT_REGEN_COLD_6H, compare mean extra joules vs profile-specific H00 reference: compute ΔE_motor and ΔE_inverter using only distinct calibration episodes and frozen Stage3 truth diagnostics; match integrated positive dissipative loss (J) within <=1% tolerance and document failures. Keep reference seeds separate from validation/test; avoid use of final held-out outcomes.
matched_M01_I01.severity_mapping: Calibrate motor→inverter map SEPARATELY for nominal and shifted full 6h driving profiles using independent, declared calibration/reference seeds (not any validation or test episode outcomes); freeze mapping before test generation. M01 ~ torque^2, so do not reuse a nominal map on the shifted profile. Report actual ΔE in J, ΔPmean in W, mismatch %, and cases outside feasible I01 severity.
matched_M01_I01.separability: Report distributions/overlap and paired effect-size; DO NOT invent classifier/AUC without Stage5; do not use truth channel to derive R33.

performance_stratification.noise_terciles_definition: Before any classification, use observed *assigned* sensor-noise scales only (no labels/results): score sqrt((sigma_torque_Nm/8)^2+(sigma_rpm/35)^2) using per-episode draws; train split alone fixes 1/3 and 2/3 score quantile edges for low/medium/high; freeze and apply same boundaries to val/test. Persistent bias is stratified separately, not folded into white noise score.
report: R33 regression versus (intercept, sum tau_j^2, sum omega_j) using only measured signals
note low-severity detection limitations and limited per-stratum precision
performance_stratification.regression_caveat: Persistent torque bias produces terms proportional to omega and changes intercept; inverter constant loss overlaps intercept/auxiliary loads. Do not claim identifiability just because regression coefficient for tau^2 differs on synthetic data.

external_validation_protocol.model_class: One-RC Thevenin ECM primary; independent two-RC Thevenin ECM reference benchmark fitted/evaluated on identical cell-level partitions. Frozen Stage3 Taycan model.py remains unchanged.
ocv_models: linear voltage vs SOC as frozen model.py functional form
degree-3 polynomial in SOC, constrained/evaluated on 0..1 domain
external_validation_protocol.fit_only: LG E66 cell HPPC, GITT, C20 and C/3 files at -20,-10,10,25 degC; files enumerated from original archive manifest before new numerical fitting; no module or whole-pack fitting
external_validation_protocol.validate: LG E66 development temperatures (-20,-10,10,25°C): ONLY Dis_0p5C is validation. Dis_1C is reserved as BLIND_TYPE for all development temperatures. At temperature holdouts 0 and 40°C, EVERY test type is BLIND_TEMPERATURE. 25°C Drive Cycle already exposed: DEVELOPMENT_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY, not blind.
external_validation_protocol.predictions: terminal V(t) under measured current profile using known initial SOC from development protocol (no fitted test SOC) and frozen input temperature treatment
external_validation_protocol.metrics: Session-level RMSE and MAE of terminal voltage in volts (and mV display), stratified by temperature and test type; compare ECM_1RC_LINEAR_OCV, ECM_1RC_CUBIC_OCV, ECM_2RC_CUBIC_OCV fitted only on development-fit; report OCV model difference and independent blind-pair results. Proposed good <=30mV, acceptable <=60mV, else fail, with source-literature benchmark held NOT VERIFIED.
external_validation_protocol.primary_threshold_assumed: Session-level blind cell-voltage RMSE <=0.030 V: GOOD; >0.030 and <=0.060 V: ACCEPTABLE; >0.060 V: FAIL. These are PRE-ASSUMED engineering categories, not Porsche or McMaster pass thresholds; report each regime/temperature, session macro and tail/worst-case regardless of category.
external_validation_protocol.scope: Tests transfer of ECM structure under cell-scale experimental regimes. Does not validate the 2022 Taycan 4S pack simulator or certified HV diagnosis.

regularized multinomial logistic regression on identical observed features, train-only standardization, validation-only tuning
metrics_and_baselines.evaluation_design: Holdout by whole episode / whole cell. Macro by episode, paired bootstrap by episode, do not split correlated timestamps across train and test.
metrics_and_baselines.baseline_guard: No classifier, network or fitting during unapproved Stage 4, except preregistration. Stage 5+ performance metrics specified but not executed; do not label pre-registration as passed acceptance.

observation_unit_and_features.observation_unit: ONE 6-hour independently seeded episode (not individual sample, not vehicle); observations at each 5- or 10-second numerical step. Full episode is assigned to exactly one train/validation/test split. With paired scenarios cluster uncertainties by independent seed/profile group.
observation_unit_and_features.per_step_raw_channels: Only the following preapproved OBDb IDs and 28x6 group-voltage / 28x3 module-temperature families: TAYCAN_HVBAT_VOLT, TAYCAN_BMS_I, TAYCAN_HVBAT_CURRENT, TAYCAN_BMS_SOC, TAYCAN_HVBAT_SOC_DISP, TAYCAN_EM_TORQ_1/2, TAYCAN_EM_RPM_1/2, TAYCAN_DIFF_MOTOR_T, TAYCAN_HV_ISO_POS_SYS, TAYCAN_HV_ISO_NEG_SYS, TAYCAN_HVBAT_ISO_POS, TAYCAN_HVBAT_ISO_NEG, TAYCAN_HVBAT_MOD{1..28}_C{1..6}_V, TAYCAN_HVBAT_MOD{1..28}_T{1..3}. No truth, labels, injected severities, fault power, parameters or seeds as features.
observation_unit_and_features.temporal_aggregation: Use only finite measured observations. At each sampled step compute derived signals as specified. Per episode aggregate exactly listed features below. std=sample SD (ddof1); slope via unweighted OLS time (hours); quantile via linear interpolation; regression via OLS intercept and measured tau2/omega terms with train-only fixed ridge=1e-9 purely numerical; mark nonestimable if rank deficient; missing numerical values imputed from TRAIN median with missingness masks fixed train-only. No label-dependent feature selection.
observation_unit_and_features.canonical_missingness: If a required channel is genuinely not emitted under a structural mode, numeric feature becomes NA, recorded with fixed 0/1 mask. Median training-only imputation and mask appended, so classifiers see the identical numeric+mask vector. Never replace missing sensors with simulated true states or silently zero.
observation_unit_and_features.shared_inputs_rule: All baselines and subsequent supervised comparators consume same 25 feature values plus 25 masks; any Bayesian network using per-step emission may ALSO be evaluated against fixed episode-level summary interface without oracle covariates, and any expanded inputs would need new explicit approval.
observation_unit_and_features.label_and_meta_policy: Hypothesis label used only as outcome, never feature. Severity, structural mode, nuisance scales, φ, profile ID, seeds, initial SOC, injected faults and latent truth are metadata for splits/stratified reporting only, NOT predictor features. No using access to held-out outcomes for feature selection.
